entries.title: Too congested before we're connected? Broadband satellites will need to navigate a crowded sky
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that more than 5,000 broadband satellites will be in LEO by the end of 2023, making up two working constellations providing high-speed internet to nearly a million subscribers
entries.metric: broadband satellites in low earth orbit
entries.subject: LEO satellite broadband

entries.title: Accessible is possible: Introducing the US$99 5G smartphone
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that 2023 will see the launch of the first 5G smartphones retailing at US$99 or its equivalent in other currencies.
entries.metric: retail price of first low-cost 5G smartphones
entries.subject: Low-cost 5G smartphones

entries.title: 5G's promised land finally arrives: 5G standalone networks can transform enterprise connectivity
entries.quote: Deloitte Global expects the number of MNOs investing in 5G SA networks—with trials, planned deployments, or actual rollouts—to double from more than 100 operators in 2022 to at least 200 by the end of 2023.
entries.subject: 5G standalone networks

entries.title: AI in chip design: Semiconductor companies are using AI to design better chips faster, cheaper, and more efficiently
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that the world's leading semiconductor companies will spend US$300 million on internal and third-party AI tools for designing chips in 2023
entries.metric: semiconductor spend on AI chip-design tools
entries.subject: AI in chip design

entries.title: Supercharged semiconductors: Chips made of newer materials surge ahead, handling the volts that would fry silicon chips
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that chips made of high-power semiconducting materials, primarily gallium nitride (GaN) and silicon carbide (SiC), will sell a combined US$3.3 billion in 2023, up almost 40% from 2022.
entries.metric: GaN and SiC power chip sales
entries.subject: Wide-bandgap semiconductors

entries.title: That's just rad! Radiation-hardened chips take space tech and nuclear energy to new heights
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that the radiation-hardened (rad hard) electronics market will top US$1.5 billion in sales globally in 2023.
entries.subject: Radiation-hardened chips

entries.title: Everyone's watching: AVOD finds an increasingly receptive audience
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that, by the end of 2023, approaching two-thirds of consumers in developed countries will use at least one advertising video-on demand (AVOD) service monthly
entries.metric: developed-country consumers using an AVOD service monthly
entries.subject: Ad-supported video on demand

entries.title: Live sports: The next arena for the streaming wars
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that in 2023, streamers will spend over US$6 billion on exclusive major sports rights in the largest global markets.
entries.metric: streamer spend on exclusive major sports rights
entries.subject: Sports streaming rights

entries.title: Virtual production gets real: Bringing real-time visual effects onto the set
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that the market for virtual production tools will grow to US$2.2 billion in 2023—up 20% from an estimated US$1.8 billion in 2022.
entries.subject: Virtual production

entries.title: As seen in your feed: Shopping goes social, trending past US$1 trillion in annual sales
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that the market for social commerce will surpass US$1 trillion globally in 2023
entries.subject: Social commerce

entries.title: Will VR go from niche to mainstream? It all depends on compelling VR content
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that the virtual reality (VR) market will generate US$7 billion in revenue globally in 2023, an impressive 50% increase over 2022's US$4.7 billion.
entries.subject: Virtual reality

entries.title: Battle for the Enterprise Edge: Providers prepare to pounce on the emerging enterprise edge computing market
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that the enterprise market for edge computing will grow at 22% in 2023
entries.subject: Edge computing

entries.title: Tech's climate commitment: Organizational and personal impacts are pushing tech leaders toward faster climate action
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that in 2023, the tech industry will move faster on climate action than nontech industries.
entries.subject: Tech industry climate action

entries.title: Let's make a deal—in gaming! Gaming M&A is growing on the back of consolidation, portfolio plays, and game tech
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that, in 2023, the number of game company mergers and acquisitions (M&A) will increase by around 25%
entries.metric: growth in number of games M&A deals
entries.subject: Games industry M&A

entries.title: TMT divestitures make a comeback: 2023 deal values in tech, media, and telecom may bounce back strongly
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that the total value of TMT divestitures in 2023 could expand by 25–50% year over year to range from US$250–300 billion
entries.subject: TMT divestitures

notes: 22nd edition by count from 2002. Grouped into five themes (section field). The Deloitte Insights edition URL serves the full report PDF. Publication month from the late November / early December launch pattern; exact day not confirmed. Rank is the order in the report.
